name: Bell's Inequality

phase_0.boundary_condition: The absolute limit of local realism and classical probability theory

VINIT.chosen_element: Initial vacuum state of the photon source
VINIT.justification: The state before any particles are generated or properties assigned, representing the unmeasured quantum void

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary that defines the maximum possible correlation any local hidden variable theory can sustain, which the quantum system ultimately transcends

AFWD.chosen_element: Unitary evolution of the pump laser
AFWD.justification: The forward temporal propagation of energy into the nonlinear crystal to drive the physical process

AREV.justification: The descent from the extended superposition state into definite local eigenstates, reversing the prior coherence

CLINK.justification: The sequential but causally disconnected composition of Alice and Bob choosing their measurement angles independently

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential mathematical object that encodes the correlations and recognizes its own non-separability across space

FSPLIT.justification: The physical morphism splitting a single high-energy pump photon into a spatially separated signal and idler photon pair

FFUSE.justification: The classical and statistical reconstitution of the joint probability distribution from separated detector clicks, recovering the original non-local correlation structure

EVALT.justification: The affirmative success state where the CHSH correlation parameter reaches 2 times the square root of 2, violating the classical bound

EVALF.justification: The negative failure state where classical probability distributions are proven mathematically incapable of reproducing the observed statistics

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice where particles are strictly localized in space yet instantaneously correlated across any distance, holding both spatial independence and holistic unity simultaneously

IFIX.chosen_element: The experimental record of Bell test violations
IFIX.justification: The permanent irreversible empirical fixation of the data in the global scientific consensus, rendering local realism theoretically obsolete

phase_2.fuse_result: The original single-photon non-local correlation structure restored as a statistical whole

phase_3.void_description: The unpopulated quantum field modes before the pump laser is activated
phase_3.true_description: The empirical observation that nature violates the Bell inequality and obeys quantum mechanics
phase_3.false_description: The classical assumption that particles carry pre-determined local hidden variables prior to measurement
phase_3.both_description: The dialetheia of the quantum state: the system is deterministically correlated globally while remaining fundamentally probabilistic locally

steps.domain_action: Initialize the vacuum state of the nonlinear crystal and optical paths before any photon generation
Propagate the pump laser beam forward in time into the nonlinear medium to induce photon pair generation
Split the single pump photon into an entangled signal and idler pair directed toward spatially separated detectors
Compose the independent measurement operations where Alice and Bob select their polarization bases without communicating
Identify the global entangled wavefunction as the self-referential entity encoding the non-local relationship between the separated photons
Collapse the extended superposition into definite local spin or polarization eigenvalues upon physical detection
Hold the paradice of the entangled state where the outcomes are strictly local in their physical registration yet perfectly non-local in their statistical correlation
Affirm the quantum mechanical prediction by calculating a CHSH parameter that exceeds the classical limit of 2
Reject the local hidden variable theory by demonstrating that no classical probability distribution can account for the measured joint statistics
Fuse the temporally staggered Alice and Bob detector clicks via coincidence logic to reconstruct the complete joint probability distribution
Seal the boundary of local realism by proving definitively that the universe does not operate on pre-determined local properties
Permanently record the experimental correlation data in the scientific literature as an irreversible falsification of classical locality

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Hamiltonian governing the light-matter interaction within the nonlinear crystal
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The shared non-separable entangled wavefunction acting as the non-local quantum channel
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The time-to-digital converters and coincidence logic arrays storing the temporal tagging of each detection event
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The asynchronous quantum random number generators dictating the spacelike separated basis selection timing
phase_5.alfs_store: The standard Dirac-von Neumann quantum formalism and the CHSH inequality mathematical baseline

phase_6.cycle_cost: Zero thermodynamic entropy transfer between the separated measurement stations for the correlation update
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Independent unentangled vacuum modes and a coherent pump laser beam
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Classical data streams of correlated measurement outcomes and a finalized joint probability tensor
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The entanglement correlations are topological and informational structures that do not require physical energy transfer or thermodynamic work between the spatially separated parties
